attchmntText: The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 450,708,052 Equity shares of Re.1/- each pursuant to issue of Rights Shares".
Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange a copy of the Corrigendum Notice to Investors of The South Indian Bank Limited.

Edelweiss Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Rights issue of equity shares of face value of Rs. 1 each (the" Equity Shares") by the South Indian Bank Limited (the "Bank") to the eligible equity shareholders of the Bank Under Regulation 10 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements), Regulations, 2009, as amended (the "SEBI Regulations")(the "Issue").

The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Capital Planning & Infusion Committee of the Bank by way of a resolution passed on February 20, 2017, has finalized the Issue opening and the Issue closing dates, including the last date of receipt of request for split application forms with respect to the proposed Issue.

The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has fixed Record Date as February 17, 2017 for the purpose of determining the shareholders eligible to apply for the equity shares in the Rights Issue.

The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board by a resolution passed has allotted 3,89,657 Equity Shares of face value Re.1/- each pursuant to exercise of options granted under the South Indian Bank Employees Stock Option Scheme (SIB ESOS - 2008). Post the above allotment, the paid-up Equity share capital of the Bank would stand at Rs. 135,21,27,907/- consisting of 135,21,27,907 Equity shares of Re.1/- each.
The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Investor Presentation
The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Interest Rates Updates

SOUTHBANK:The Exchange has sought clarification from with respect to announcement dated 11-Jan-2017, that Mr. Achal Kumar Gupta, has been appointed as an Additional Director of the Bank w.e.f. January 11, 2017.On basis of above the Company is required to clarify following:1. Brief profile (in case of appointment);2. Disclosure of relationships between directors (in case of appointment of a director).The response of the Company is attached.

January 11, 2017.On basis of above the Company is required to clarify following:1. Brief profile (in case of appointment);2. Disclosure of relationships between directors (in case of appointment of a director).The response of the Company is awaited.
The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that Mr. Achal Kumar Gupta, has been appointed as an Additional Director of the Bank w.e.f. January 11, 2017.
The South Indian Bank Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended 31-Dec-2016.
The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates

The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of The Bank at their meeting held on December 21, 2016, has decided to issue equity shares of face value of Re. 1 each ( Equity Shares ) of the Bank, to the existing shareholders of the Bank on a rights basis ( Rights Issue ) in the ratio of 1:3 i.e. one Equity Shares for every three Equity Shares held on a record date to be fixed at a later date, at a price of Rs. 14 per Equity Share, including a premium of Rs. 13 per Equity Share, subject to necessary approvals.
The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that, Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates (MCLR) applicable for multiple tenors has been revised w.e.f. December 01, 2016.

The South Indian Bank Limited has informed the Exchange that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board by a resolution passed on November 29, 2016 has allotted 4,500 Equity Shares of face value Re.1/- each pursuant to exercise of options granted under the South Indian Bank Employees Stock Option Scheme (SIB ESOS - 2008). Post the above allotment, the paid-up Equity share capital of the Bank would stand at Rs. 135,17,38,250/- consisting of 135,17,38,250 Equity shares of Re.1/- each.
